meta.method: TF-IDF char_wb(3,5) cosine over normalised title|company|location, blocked by company, union-find clustering
meta.blocking_recall_ceiling: cross-employer duplicates are out of scope by construction

removable_is_an_upper_bound.reading: these clusters collapse a (title, company, location) triple to one distinct ROLE. They are not a count of scraping artifacts: nearly every removable row has its own URL, and a third sit in clusters spanning several posting dates -- re-announcements and simultaneous openings, which no (title, company, location) label can tell apart from a true duplicate.

meta.note: nothing is deleted from postings.json; this records WHICH rows are duplicates so a consumer can choose.
